prior_importants.description: A flaky pass now writes an absolute path into the operator's home store (`~/.pupitre/<projectId>/sessions/<id>/test-output.log`, or `full output not kept: no directory at <dir>`). That detail goes into the passed gate report, which is the body of the PR posted to GitHub.

findings.description: The baseline coverage gap reason now ends with `full output: ~/.pupitre/<projectId>/test-output.log` (absolute). That reason feeds the audit findings, `pup audit --sweep` puts them into the sweep task's goal (`buildSweepTask`), and `prBody` publishes the goal under `## Goal`, so a gated sweep PR names the operator's store path on GitHub. The same goal already carries the repo path via the `test fails at baseline … on <repoPath>` finding, so only the store location and projectId are new; keeping the path out of `gap.reason` (a separate local line) avoids it.

A web dashboard merge (`mergeAction`, src/core/web-dashboard-actions.service.ts:223) passes no `progress`, so the flaky pass's new kept-output note goes only to the `pup web` server's stderr via `NO_PROGRESS.note`. The page builds its lines from stage details only, so a dashboard user is no longer told where the first run's full output was kept.
